ev_0005.summary: Circle centered at O=(284.2,312.95), radius 236.0 (full circle). A and B are diametrically opposite on it, joined by solid vertical diameter AB at x=284. E and F lie on the circle on the horizontal line y=431, joined by solid segment EF; D=(284,431) is the foot of the vertical from A onto EF and lies on both AB and EF. Triangle AEF is inscribed with solid sides AE and AF. OE and OF are dashed radii. Segment endpoints snapped to labelled vertices (overshoots of 5-8 px are detector noise). No right-angle marker was verified at D, so no right_angle object is emitted; the AD perpendicular to EF is geometrically implied but is recorded as a candidate relation only. Label bindings A,B,D,E,F,O taken from the supervisor's verified template binding; E was NCC 0.85 but consistent with the figure.
